title: The Toll
text: You ask how the fleet is crewed. The coast pays its tithe at the harbour mouth, one crew in every ten ships that come in. The Harbourmaster writes them in his book. I sing to them after. Do not ask me again in a letter.
note: Pressed in the Harbourmaster's berths' book, at the page where the crews were written in.
where: The Drowned Mole, the outer mole's end
